evidence.finding: PlanEditor mutates spans, openings, opening reinforcements, and wallExtent; the verification scan found no free Member collection mutation.
SectionTable replaces Section values only and does not add or remove Member objects.
The import path has an explicit candidate-approval 反映 button that calls applyFramingPlan; it is not free placement.
Member ids are `${storyId}-${placement.mark}-${placement.ix}-${placement.iy}` with `-${axis}` appended for 辺 placements; duplicate generated ids are deduplicated by Map before returning.
serializeProject/deserializeProject round-trip duplicate member ids because uniqueness is not part of the deserialization checks.
Member lookup and selection use the first project.members.find result for a duplicate id.
Quantity aggregation maps members by id and counts places from a Set of member ids, so duplicate ids collapse distinct members.
AppState exposes updateProject/loadProject but no undo, redo, or history action/stack.
UI edits call updateProject directly; no history mechanism is present.

summary: ADR-038의 6개 전제 모두 코드와 실행으로 upheld. 大梁 없는 耐震壁 및 4변 지지 미완료 床板은 plain Error 경로로 훅/산정 경계를 벗어나며, 伏図 취입과 직렬화는 이 상태를 도달 가능하게 하고, 중복 ID는 직렬화 후 수량 places를 축소한다.
